artifacts.summary: 5-phase implementation summary: per-candidate A2-triangle leg (i)/(iii) comparison via a compile-once solver-free evaluator, with no genuine A2 divergence found across all six Tier 1 cases.

memory_candidates.content: In this repo's ModelConstraints (models/constraints.py), all_constraints is computed via list concatenation inside __init__, before BimodalSemantics.finalize_certificate() extends frame_constraints in place from BimodalStructure._setup_solver -- so all_constraints is stale (missing the bulk of the encoding) for any structure built via the Syntax -> ModelConstraints -> BimodalStructure pipeline. Use ModelConstraints.frame_constraints (re-concatenated with model_constraints/premise_constraints/conclusion_constraints after construction) instead of all_constraints when the full, post-solve constraint set is needed; confirmed against models/structure.py's own solve path, which reads frame_constraints directly.

Compile-once, interpret-many pattern for solver-free Z3 BoolRef evaluation: walk each constraint's AST exactly once, intern leaf atom names into an integer index, and emit a Python closure per top-level constraint over that index. The hot per-candidate/per-row path then does only list indexing and native bool operations, no further Z3 API calls -- matching a pure-Python re-checker's own cost profile instead of paying a Z3 Python/C-API call per AST node per candidate. Worked example: code/src/model_checker/theory_lib/bimodal/tests/_pinned_eval.py.

next_steps: All 5 phases complete; full gate green for this task's scope (3 pre-existing, unrelated failures documented). No A2 finding to diagnose. Task ready to close.
